hotspots.title: Meloni’s coalition strength tested in Italy
hotspots.blurb: Italy’s Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni faces challenges in maintaining her coalition’s strength, particularly with the Lega party over issues like EU policy, energy spending, and local election outcomes. The coalition's unity is being tested by internal disagreements and external pressures.
hotspots.affect: This hotspot is charged due to the high-stakes political maneuvering, moral panic over Italy’s economic future, and the polarized contention between coalition partners.
